split.label: Split DNS zones
split.summary: Optional. Send a domain to its own resolver: domain=IP, one per line.
split.info: Private-IP resolvers are trusted without DNSSEC. IP#TLS-name uses DNS over TLS with DNSSEC. Separate backup resolvers with commas; zones never fall back to the main resolver.
split.invalid: Check the domain names and resolver addresses. Up to 16 zones.

review.title: Review DNS changes

resolver.preserve: Keep current resolver and split DNS zones
resolver.dnsOverTls: DNS over TLS, no plaintext fallback
resolver.dnsOverHttps: DNS over HTTPS, no plaintext fallback

review.impact: Affects every device on this server, and the VPN restarts briefly. VPN addresses, ports, devices and access stay the same.

blocklist.title: Ad and tracker blocking
blocklist.summary: Blocks ad and tracker domains for every device that uses this server’s DNS. The server keeps no record of lookups.
blocklist.unsupported: Repair this server with the current app to use DNS blocking.
blocklist.customHint: Optional. One HTTPS address per line, hosts or domain-list format.
blocklist.customInvalid: Use up to 8 HTTPS addresses in total.
blocklist.allowlistHint: One domain per line. Its subdomains are allowed too.
blocklist.allowlistInvalid: Use valid domain names, up to 512.
blocklist.saved: Saved. The server applies it within a minute.
blocklist.loadFailed: DNS blocking settings could not be loaded.
blocklist.saveFailed: DNS blocking settings could not be saved.

status.pending: Waiting for the server to apply the latest change.

failure.download: A blocklist could not be downloaded. The last good list stays in effect.
failure.format: A blocklist is not in hosts or domain-list format. The last good list stays in effect.
failure.too_many_domains: The chosen lists contain more than 300,000 domains. Choose fewer lists; the last good list stays in effect.
failure.resolver: The DNS service rejected the new list. The last good list stays in effect.
